metadata.title: A Chord-Arc Estimate for Graphical Hypersurfaces
metadata.abstract: We prove an interior chord-arc estimate for graphical hypersurfaces without an a priori gradient bound, which is not restricted to balls on the scale of their curvature. As a main application we derive an in-radius lower bound depending on the curvature which then also implies Heinz-type estimates for minimal graphs and uniform area bounds for graphical hypersurfaces.
